question: 单项选择：This is _____ movie I have ever seen. A. good  B. better  C. best  D. the best
answer: 答案：D. the best。解析：good的最高级是the best。

question: 单项选择：That was _____ day of my life. A. bad  B. worse  C. worst  D. the worst
answer: 答案：D. the worst。解析：bad的最高级是the worst。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He has ______ (many) books in our class.
answer: 答案：the most。解析：many的最高级是the most。

question: 单项选择：This is _____ story in the book. A. little  B. less  C. least  D. the least
answer: 答案：D. the least。解析：little的最高级是the least。

question: 翻译句子：哪条路是去火车站最远的？
answer: 答案：Which is the farthest way to the train station? 解析：far的最高级是the farthest或the furthest。

question: 单项选择：She is _____ student in our school. A. good  B. better  C. best  D. the best
answer: 答案：D. the best。解析：good的最高级是the best。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：Of all the subjects, I like English ______ (well).
answer: 答案：the best。解析：well的最高级是the best。

question: 单项选择：Of all the students, Tom is _____. He always gets the lowest mark. A. bad  B. worse  C. worst  D. the worst
answer: 答案：D. the worst。解析：bad的最高级是the worst。

question: 翻译句子：这是我吃过的最好吃的食物。
answer: 答案：This is the most delicious food I have ever eaten. 解析：delicious是多音节形容词，最高级前加the most。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：This is ______ (much) interesting book of the three.
answer: 答案：the most。解析：much的最高级是the most。
